verdict.rationale: Kit has no CLI or CI runner, but its V4 REST API is a documented headless interface. API keys are explicitly offered 'for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account', and the docs pitch the API for automating custom workflows, with bulk/async processing and callbacks for unattended jobs. The remote Kit MCP also lets AI clients act on an account without the UI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
